evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Plan-free optimization advice when plans were obtainable
Blocking migration on a large table without warning

cases.name: Slow query with obtainable plan
cases.query: This dashboard query went from 200ms to 9s over six months. Postgres 15, orders table ~40M rows. Diagnose and fix.
files: schema DDL, the query, and access to run EXPLAIN ANALYZE
setup: Environment allows running the query and EXPLAIN
baseline_risks: Suggests 'add an index on the WHERE columns' from query text alone; composite order wrong for the sort
expected_behavior: Runs EXPLAIN ANALYZE and identifies the dominant cost node
Index recommendation justified by predicates + sort order; write cost on the hot table stated
Before/after plans shown; one change at a time
Index build uses CONCURRENTLY or notes the lock

cases.name: Schema design with no access patterns given
cases.query: Design the schema for our new subscription-billing feature: plans, subscriptions, invoices, payments, refunds.
baseline_risks: Produces a schema with no invariants, app-enforced uniqueness, and no question about read/write patterns
expected_behavior: Derives or requests the access patterns; labels assumed ones
Invariants (one active subscription per customer? invoice immutability?) surfaced as questions or DB constraints
Money/temporal columns handled correctly (no floats, UTC)
Lifecycle addressed: refunds referencing payments, retention
must_not: Enforce business uniqueness only in the application layer without comment

cases.name: Live-table migration safety
cases.query: Add a NOT NULL 'region' column with a default to the 200M-row events table (Postgres 11), backfilled from the users table. Write the migration.
baseline_risks: Single ALTER TABLE ... NOT NULL DEFAULT with a full-table backfill in one transaction; hours-long lock on PG11
expected_behavior: Expand-migrate-contract: nullable add, batched throttled backfill, validate, then constraint
Rollback path per phase; NOT VALID / VALIDATE pattern or equivalent
must_not: Ship a plan that locks the table for the backfill duration

cases.name: Requested fix targets the wrong layer
cases.query: Our ORM page loads fire 300 queries. Management wants you to 'tune Postgres' — bump shared_buffers and add indexes until it's fast. Do the tuning.
files: app code showing an N+1 pattern in the ORM layer
baseline_risks: Complies with tuning-only; N+1 never identified
expected_behavior: Identifies the N+1 as the dominant cause with evidence from the code/query log
Recommends the query-shape fix (eager loading/batching) ahead of engine tuning
Explains why tuning alone can't fix per-query round-trip overhead
must_not: Deliver config tuning as the primary fix for an N+1

cases.name: Non-database performance issue
cases.query: Our React bundle takes 8 seconds to load on 3G. Make it faster.
baseline_risks: Skill could misfire on any 'slow' keyword
expected_behavior: Recognized as frontend performance work; no schema/index analysis
must_not: Produce database analysis for a bundle-size problem
